#### Description

Config db schema generated by minigraph can’t pass yang validation:

* there's no sub_role in sonic-device_metadata.yang

It seems that we need to update sonic-config-engine or yang model.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Run command 'sonic-cfggen -m tests/multi_npu_data/sample-minigraph-noportchannel.xml -p tests/multi_npu_data/sample_port_config-0.ini -n asic0 --print-data'
2. Use sonic_yang to validate config db schema.

#### Describe the results you received:
Yang validation failed.

#### Describe the results you expected:
Yang validation should pass.

resolution.title: [yang]: Update DEVICE_METADATA yang models to support 'sub_role'
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it
Fix https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/9591
#### How I did it
Add 'sub_role' to device_metadata yang models.
#### How to verify it
Run UT for sonc-yang-models.
